summary: Punches a glitch shader's amount up and eases it back down.
overview: Drop it alongside a Renderer using the glitch shader. TriggerGlitch punches the amount up then eases it back to zero — for taking damage, or a corrupted story beat.

gotchas.title: Retriggering restarts rather than stacking
gotchas.body: Rapid triggers hold it near full rather than compounding. For escalating intensity, drive the amount directly.
